rev6.release_notes: Pressing PLAY on a lathe program no longer stops with an error. The add-in's Scan and Launch buttons now open this version of G-SEND.IO instead of the older one. If your CAD software was open during the update, restart it after this update installs.

cadcam.release_notes: Operation panels are simpler: no summary line, pick buttons in one column, a new Start at option, and a new default pocket stepover. In the browser, names fill the row, toolpaths can be separated or combined, and CAD mode hides the CAM rows. New tool models for a 2 inch four-tooth face mill and its holder.
